issue_text:
win: properly initialize OSVERSIONINFOW

Otherwise calling `RtlGetVersion()` might produce UB. Problem was causing random crashes in the node.js test suite with stack traces like this one: ``` node.exe!__report_gsfailure(unsigned __int64 stack_cookie) Line 220 	at D:\a\_work\1\s\src\vctools\crt\vcstartup\src\gs\gs_report.c(220) node.exe!uv__tcp_keepalive(uv_tcp_s * socket, unsigned __int64 on, int idle, unsigned int intvl, unsigned i

win: fix watch loop logic

As described in the original Node.js issue, and [my comment there](https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/61398#issuecomment-3817738965), there is a bug when permanently deleting a watched file on Windows. This PR fixes it. I've tested this directly in Node.js before opening the PR.  Refs: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/61398

unix: improve handling of uv_async_send mistakes

When the user calls uv_async_send concurrently with uv_loop_close, we try to prevent that data race from actually accessing undefined behavior by setting the pending flag atomically with the busy flag. This was proposed in the original PR, but we didn't have motivation to go with this implementation until a user pointed out that it improves behavior of this unlikely race window in more cases.  C

test: use correct type for uv_fileno arguments

Fixes a -Wincompatible-pointer-types error on Windows, since uv_os_fd_t is not int but HANDLE.

unix: use posix_spawn instead of fork

Remove the conditionals so that posix_spawn will be used whenever possible, and not only on Apple.

win,pipe: skip IOCP for pipe handles

Copy the optimization from tcp/udp stack: when read/writes don't require IOCP to complete, put them directly right into the pending queue, so they can be processed without a full loop through IOCP each time to drain them asyncronously.

fix build on termux

changes: fixed mission difinitions in android's limits.h only include fdsan on android api >= 29  this fixes #5092

unix: enforce recvmmsg buffer size requirements

The documentation already stated that the receive buffer should be a multiple of 64 KiB when the UV_UDP_RECVMMSG is used, but make that more prominent in the documentation and enforce it in the code.  Refs: https://github.com/libuv/libuv/security/advisories/GHSA-r846-fxvr-f3rx

linux: close streams without an extra read

From examining the code, it seemed like libuv may attempt an extraneous read after the kernel reports there is no data remaining, in order to check if there is data remaining (particularly since 24bfef2ef4b5ac3e47f037f0f6759ad63b5d1e96).

test: fix -Wunused-function warning

The function is only used on BSDs. Introduced in commit 919b92d9 ("unix: support long path names in pipe.c") from a few days ago.
